data: What is the average score on all GLUE tasks for the blue line when 4 billion tokens are used for training?

The question asks for the average score on all GLUE tasks for the blue line when 4 billion tokens are used for training. From the caption, we know that the blue line represents the MLM model. The x-axis of the graph shows the number of tokens used for training, ranging from 1 to 10 billion. The y-axis shows the average score on tasks, ranging from 70 to 80. 

Looking at the graph, we can see that the blue line (MLM) starts at approximately 72 on the y-axis when the x-axis value is 1 billion. As the x-axis value increases to 4 billion, the blue line rises to approximately 76. Therefore, the average score on all GLUE tasks for the blue line when 4 billion tokens are used for training is approximately 76.
